video.title: NEW STEAM Updates and FEATURES REVEALED!

protocol.note: Drafted from the transcript alone, without seeing any jevcut output or other labels.
protocol.times_from: Lemonfox transcript; seconds in the source, so labels survive re-transcription

clips.why: Personal story: 'Remote play experiences for me have always been garbage' (hook), with the 'your boy ain't gonna pay a premium for fast internet' aside and OnLive, landing on the Steam Deck anecdote: in the same room as his PC, trying to play from his bed, and it still lagged (242.1). Can also run to 'this isn't how I want to play games... not my cup of tea' (252.9). The earlier 'I'm gonna be real with you guys' / 'low IQ' run-up (175-197) is preamble.

Hot take: the two game-breakers for him are input delay and stuttering; even a micro-stutter every minute or two is infuriating. Punchline: 'I would rather a game run at 30 FPS than play a game at 60 FPS that stutters every now and again.' Opens on 'to me, the two biggest things that are game breaking' (dropping 'But'). ~33s.

also_ok.why: Valve is bridging PC and console with Steam Machine and Deck; big picture is one of the best dashboards in gaming, ranked behind PS5 and ahead of Xbox. Mild opinion that leans on the Big Art mode shown on screen; acceptable, not essential.

negatives.why: Reading Valve's PyroWave post off screen: bandwidth figures, 4:4:4, HDR, bitrate ranges. Numbers-heavy screen narration.
Reading the September 9 Steam client beta patch notes (Big Art mode, screensavers, bug fixes); screen narration though introduced with 'I'm really excited'.
Intro previewing the two updates; no payoff.
Wrap-up recap restating both updates and his remote play opinion.
